newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady, except bullish gas oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, except bullish gas oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Wednesday, except gas oil which shot up.
Gasoline ended down $1, hurt by a rise in U.S. gasoline stocks but buoyed by a rise in Brent crude and heavy Eurograde buying by a Scandanavian producer.
Naphtha was steady and end user demand appeared satisfied. Swaps fell 50 cents.
Gas oil jumped $6.00 as arbitrage traders, watching strong demand in Asia, piled up length in the European market.
Fuel oil was steady in a quiet market despite bullish support from crude. Barges recovered early losses.
